title: 電気磁気学Ⅲ
subtitle: Electromagnetics III
teachers:
YANAGIBASHI Hideyuki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
(1) Students will learn the magnetic material, especially ferromagnetic materials, and learn its characteristics including non-linearity and the hysteresis.
(2) Students will learn the magnetic circuit concept.
(3) Students will learn the electromagnetic wave which is introduced from Maxwell equations and will aquire the ability to solve basic problems such as reflection of the wave and Poynting vector.
advice:
This course is focused on the magnetic materials and electromagnetic wave. We will cover the following materials:
1. Magnetic material
2. Magnetic Circuit
3. Electromagnetic wave
Students are expected to solve the exercises by yourself.
Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms and formulas.
Students are expected to resolve the not well understood materials from the class by reviewing.
If necessary, learning may take place using digital methods such as online (distance) or on-demand classes.
requiredKnowledge:
Background knowledge of “Electromagnetics I” and “Electromagnetics II”.
Basic knowledge of mathematics such as vector analysis and calculus of line, surface and volume integration.
Basic knowledge of electric circuit.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the phenomenon of magnetization and solve the fundamental problems in magnetic fields.
Be able to understand the magnetic circuit concept and solve the basic problem of magnetic flux and magnetic fie
Be able to understand the nature of electromagnetic waves and solve related fundamental problems.
